definitions.explanation: A cascade of water falling from a height.

examples.english: I went to see a waterfall.

examples.japanese: {滝|たき}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the waterfall.

notes:
{滝|たき} means waterfall.

FAMOUS WATERFALLS:
- {華厳|けごん}の{滝|たき}: Kegon Falls (Nikko)
- {那智|なち}の{滝|たき}: Nachi Falls (Wakayama)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {滝|たき}のような{汗|あせ}: sweating profusely (like a waterfall)
- {滝行|たきぎょう}: waterfall meditation (standing under a waterfall)
